extraction: SPOQ journal tracking system and skill framework details. Journal tracking records agent work sessions with structured metadata enabling explainability, meta-orchestration, and training data generation. Combined with git commits, journal entries provide rich examples for fine-tuning development-focused LLMs. Skill framework: Definition 5.3 (Skill) is a directory containing SKILL.md (required), scripts/ (optional), references/ (optional), assets/ (optional). Core SPOQ Skills: six skills aligned with four-stage pipeline (Table B.15 Appendix). Skill Invocation: via slash commands (/epic-planning, /agent-execution) expanding into full prompts with context from epic directory. Skill SKILL.md contains YAML frontmatter (name, description) followed by structured documentation: activation criteria, core patterns, quality standards, integration points. Skill Extensibility: skill-maker meta-skill enables creation of new domain-specific skills. Allows SPOQ deployments to accumulate organizational knowledge as reusable agent capabilities.
